name: Kolkata
summary: The City of Joy: colonial architecture, trams, the Hooghly, sweets, book streets and big shopping. The most popular India trip from Dhaka, only an hour by air.
season_note: October to February is cool and dry; Durga Puja (Sept/Oct) is spectacular but very crowded and hotels fill. June to September is hot and rainy.
avoid_note: Peak summer (April-June) is hot and humid. Durga Puja days have heavy road closures.
entry_note: Indian visa is required for Bangladeshi passport holders (apply via the Indian Visa Application Centre, usually medical/tourist/e-visa categories as currently offered). Check the latest rules with the embassy before booking.

reach.how: Dhaka to Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Airport (Biman, US-Bangla, IndiGo, Air India)
reach.note: Shortest route. Return fares are roughly double.

reach.how: AC bus Dhaka to Kolkata via Benapole-Petrapole (Shyamoli, Green Line, Hanif, Sohag Paribahan)
reach.note: Immigration at the border can take 1-3 hours.

reach.how: Maitree Express Dhaka Cantonment to Kolkata (runs on set days; check schedule)
reach.note: Immigration on board/at station; book well ahead.

local.note: Cleanest and fastest way across the city.
Use Uber/Ola or insist on the meter.

attractions.name: Victoria Memorial
attractions.what: A white-marble museum and gardens built in memory of Queen Victoria.
attractions.tip: Gardens are free-ish; museum has a separate ticket. Closed on Mondays.

attractions.name: Howrah Bridge and Flower Market
attractions.what: The giant cantilever bridge over the Hooghly and the huge Mullick Ghat flower market.
attractions.tip: Go early morning for the market and watch for pickpockets.

attractions.name: New Market and Park Street
attractions.what: Colonial-era market for clothes, leather, sweets and gifts; Park Street has famous cafes.
attractions.tip: Bargain hard in New Market; many shops close on Sunday.

attractions.name: Kalighat Kali Temple
attractions.what: One of the most revered Hindu temples in Bengal.
attractions.tip: Remove shoes, dress modestly, keep belongings secure in the queue.

attractions.name: Dakshineswar and Belur Math
attractions.what: Riverside temple and the Ramakrishna Mission headquarters, both calm and architecturally striking.
attractions.tip: Belur Math has a midday closure; check timings.

attractions.name: Indian Museum
attractions.what: The oldest museum in India with Egyptian mummy, fossils and Mughal art.
attractions.tip: Allow two hours; photography rules apply in some galleries.

attractions.name: Prinsep Ghat and Hooghly Boat Ride
attractions.what: Sunset spot by the river with the Vidyasagar Setu in view.
attractions.tip: Take a short ferry ride at sunset.

attractions.name: College Street Boi Para
attractions.what: Asia's largest second-hand book market and the famous Indian Coffee House.

rules: Keep passport/visa copies; foreigners must carry ID.
Dress modestly in temples and remove shoes.
Use app cabs or prepaid taxis from the airport to avoid overcharging.
Photography near bridges, military zones and inside some temples is restricted.
packing: Cash in INR in small notes
